routes.name: Côte d'Ivoire e-visa (airport pick-up)
routes.summary: Apply online for pre-enrollment, then get the visa at the airport. For ordinary passports only. Fingerprints are taken on arrival.

other: Ordinary passport valid at least 6 months
Yellow fever vaccination certificate shown at the airport
Which nationalities are visa-free (including ECOWAS) not confirmed on this page, check before applying

stay.note: The official page says the visa lasts 3 months with multiple entries. Max stay per entry is not stated.

steps: Apply on the official e-visa portal and upload the passport page, flight booking and invitation or accommodation proof.
Receive the approval by email with a barcode.
Collect the visa at the airport.

fees.label: E-visa (70 EUR file fee plus 3 EUR commission)

routes.processing: Document checks may take more than 48 working hours, per the official page.

routes.name: Biometric visa (embassy)
routes.summary: Apply in person at an embassy or consulate. Photos and fingerprints are taken at application and at collection.

other: Not needed if you already hold a Côte d'Ivoire residence permit (the FAQ answers "No" to needing a visa with a residence permit)
Nationality rules not confirmed, check with the embassy

stay.note: Single entry, 3 months. Can't be changed to multiple entry. Stays over 3 months are extended in country through a residence permit.

fees.label: Biometric visa (50 EUR file, 5 EUR appointment, 3 EUR online commission)

routes.processing: Photos and fingerprints at the appointment. The visa is collected about 48 hours after enrollment, per the SNEDAI FAQ.
